topStories.headline: Supreme Court Blocks Trump from Firing Fed Governor Lisa Cook
topStories.summary: The Supreme Court ruled 5-4 that Fed Governor Lisa Cook — whom Trump attempted to remove in August 2025 on disputed mortgage fraud allegations — can remain at the Federal Reserve, while a separate ruling expanded the president's power to fire top officials at other federal agencies.
topStories.marketImpact: Bonds ↑ as Fed independence and policy-path predictability are preserved; USD watch as executive pressure on rate-setting is curtailed

topStories.headline: Alphabet Makes Dow Debut, Lifting Index Past 52,000 for First Time
topStories.summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) replaced Verizon in the Dow Jones Industrial Average and climbed nearly 5% on its first trading day as a Dow member, helping the index close at 52,182.74 while the S&P 500 gained 1.18% and the Nasdaq surged 2.07%.
topStories.marketImpact: GOOGL ↑ on index inclusion demand; Dow index funds rebalancing ↑; broader tech sector lifted; Verizon (VZ) ↓ on index removal

topStories.headline: Comcast to Spin Off NBCUniversal and Sky Into Standalone Public Company
topStories.summary: Comcast announced it will separate its media portfolio — including NBCUniversal and Sky — into an independent publicly traded entity, with Comcast co-CEO Mike Cavanagh leading the new media company and CFO Michael Angelakis running the telecom business.
topStories.marketImpact: CMCSA ↑ ~4–6%; CHTR ↑ on sector-wide relief; media M&A sentiment improving

topStories.headline: SpaceX Fast-Tracked into Nasdaq-100, Set to Join July 7
topStories.summary: Weeks after its blockbuster June 12 IPO, SpaceX has been approved for fast-track entry into the Nasdaq-100, with index-tracking funds set to begin buying after July 6's close and the company officially joining before markets open July 7.
topStories.marketImpact: SPCX ↑ on pending passive fund inflows; QQQ constituents rebalanced; mechanical buying pressure expected before July 7

topStories.headline: China June PMI Beats Forecasts as Tech Export Demand Surges
topStories.summary: China's official manufacturing PMI rose to 50.3 in June — above the 50.1 estimate — driven by a sharp pickup in high-tech exports, with US-bound shipments growing 35.4% year-over-year in May and freight rates between Asia and the US hitting a near two-year high.
topStories.marketImpact: FXI ↑; global semiconductor and tech supply chain ↑; shipping stocks ↑; watch US-China tariff negotiations as importers front-run potential tariff increases

topStories.headline: Ukraine Drone Strikes Ignite Russian Refineries; Putin Acknowledges Fuel Shortages
topStories.summary: Ukraine struck refineries in Krasnodar and Yaroslavl overnight, extending a campaign that has triggered fuel rationing across two-thirds of Russia's regions; Putin publicly acknowledged the country faces a "difficult period" in a state TV interview, his most candid admission yet.
topStories.marketImpact: Russian oil output risk elevated; Brent crude watch ↑; XOM and CVX could see modest tailwinds from supply uncertainty; USO watch
